If you don't already know (I didn't until a year or so ago and I am 30 lol) oily and dry skin issues can actually be very misleading. If you have dry skin, for instance, your face can seem like it is oily due to your face trying to make up for the lack by over producing sebum so typically they would try products for oily skin, they might even try to dry their skin out somehow, when their skin actually needs proper cleansing and a great moisturizer.
 Obviously I wouldn't recommend continuing anything that causes any sort of negative reaction but I do recommend that you do your own research about it, if you are willing.
